resources.string: Allow Memory Editor over the game

Memory Editor is shown over the running MIDlet from a separate process. Keeping its Compose UI outside the MIDlet process avoids editor UI allocations and garbage collections from disturbing memory searches.\n\nOn the next Android screen, allow JL-Mod Plus to display over other apps.
This permission is used only while Memory Editor is enabled. Hiding the editor returns you to the game; turning Memory Editor off removes the overlay completely.
